leadText:
Mira (Japanese: ミラばあさん Grandma Mila) is a character of the day who appeared in Hoopa — The Mischief Pokémon. She runs a store in Arche Valley.

 had accidentally transported candy from her store and had it rain down on Old Man Dom. It had misunderstood a request by Baraz, Meray, Lucianne, Pit, and Kevie, who wanted Hoopa to make actual rain appear to help fight the drought Old Man Dom had problems with. Thinking they had done it on purpose, Mira scolded them for it and told them that they should teach Hoopa properly instead of only using it for pulling pranks on others.

To make up for what they had done, she also had them help her make donuts. As she went off to do other things, however, the children accidentally broke an ivory statue she treasured. Mira ultimately discovered this, but she wasn't mad at them as they had done their best to repair it. Afterwards they all enjoyed the donuts they made together.
